messages:
Anya: quick check-in — drafting a telemetry + dashboard plan for continuous batching metrics. sketch + brief PR: https://redwood.link/batch-metrics-sketch. Need runtime/infra/observability input on tags, emission frequency, and rollout UX. cc @Mike @Olivia @Sara @Kevin

Mike: thanks — can you enumerate the signals you want? my first pass: batch_size_distribution, wait_time_ms (p50/p95/p99), fill_rate, pool_utilization, queue_depth, aborted_batches_count. anything else?

Olivia: that list looks good. implementation note: histograms for batch_size and wait_time are doable but expensive at high cardinality. recommend emitted buckets be aggregated in-process and flushed per-worker once per second. tag set proposal: {model_version, region, priority, route_id, latency_class}. avoid tenant-level tags on histos unless sampled.

Sara: observability POV: prefer summarized quantiles for per-route dashboards (hdr/tdigest) and coarse histograms for heatmaps. histos+high-card tags = cost spike. maybe two streams: aggregate histo (no tenant/route) + per-route quantiles.

Anya: agreed — my thought: 1) high-level aggregate heatmaps (region/model) using dense histo; 2) route-level panels use quantiles + counts. :thinking_face: Also want fill_rate and batch_fill_time to correlate with saturation.

Kevin: console/UX input — we should make panels toggleable: default to aggregate for orgs < 10 routes, enable per-route only for pilots or paid tiers. rollout should be a feature-flag on control plane plus a per-customer toggle in Console.

Mike: runtime constraints: emitting full histo per request is not acceptable. we can maintain local buckets per dispatcher loop and emit a single aggregated sample per flush. that keeps CPU on-path minimal. important to define flush interval and bucket schema.

Olivia: agreed. propose flush_interval=1s, max_buckets=50 for batch_size (log buckets), wait_ms buckets tuned per latency_class. also recommend sampling fraction be configurable per customer plan. we'll need to update metric schema and estimate cardinality impact.

Sara: for alerting we should define saturation indicators. proposal: pool_util >= 85% AND p95(wait_ms) > threshold => saturation alert. thresholds by latency_class: low-latency p95 >= 100ms, medium >= 250ms, high >= 500ms. happy to iterate.

Anya: sounds reasonable. can runtime emit latency_class tag so we can drive alert thresholds?

Mike: yes, runtime can annotate dispatch metrics with latency_class and model_profile. we'll add that to the flush payload.

Olivia: telemetry cost note: tagging by tenant+route will multiply metrics cardinality. estimate 3-4x for sampled histos, and 8-10x for full per-route quantiles. recommend per-plan sampling + 7d retention for per-route, 30d for aggregate. will post numbers.

Kevin: rollout plan idea: alpha internal only -> 2 pilot customers (SE-assisted) -> gradual enable by feature flag per-account. Console should show estimated cost delta before enabling.

Anya: action items: (1) @Mike — implement in-process buckets + flush PR by EOW; (2) @Olivia — publish metric schema + cardinality estimate; (3) @Sara — draft dashboard panels + alert queries; (4) @Kevin — define pilot criteria and console toggle copy. I'll open GH issue to track. :rocket:

Mike: assigning to myself for 1, will open draft PR today. :thumbsup:

Olivia: I'll drop a schema doc in #eng-infra and link here. expect numbers by EOD. :eyes:

Sara: draft dashboard ready, I'll share a link in ~2hrs. panels: heatmap(batch_size), line(fill_rate), stacked(pool_util) + per-route quantile tile.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: created INF-2345 to track metric-schema change and telemetry estimates.

Anya: thank you all. keeping the thread as the single source of truth — ping me if you need to deviate from the plan.
